summary: Preparación de la declaración anual ante la Belastingdienst (Países Bajos): hoja de trabajo paso a paso (renta de empresario o sociedades), IVA por trimestre, lista de lo que pide la declaración y plazos. Todas las cifras fiscales viven en paquetes de reglas por año, con sus fuentes.
dataClassification: confidential-financial (figures are host inputs; the module stores nothing)
invariants: No tax figure is written in code: rates, thresholds, deductions and deadlines come from a validated rule pack (tests enforce it).
A figure is `verified` only with ≥ 2 different publishers and at least one official/primary source; otherwise `single_source` and it is listed in warnings.
No pack for the requested year → no calculation (never extrapolates another year).
A pack older than staleAfterDays is flagged in every worksheet.
An unregistered company or unknown legal form gets no tax estimate.
Entrepreneur deductions are applied only with hours on record (urencriterium); starter status must be confirmed by the user.
Rule packs from outside are data: validated (https sources, growing brackets, known source ids), never executed.
Every worksheet carries the disclaimer: preparation, not filing, not tax advice.
api: validateRulePack · selectPack · packHealth · citation · bracketTax · buildWorksheet(figures, pack, today) · vatByQuarter(entries, year, accounts, pack)

mounts.product: JANUS · administración de la empresa (solo Founder)

plannedMounts: Infinity Business Assistant (IBA) para clientes en Países Bajos
Paquetes de otros países como piezas hermanas (misma forma de paquete, otro motor)
reuseNotes: Feed it profit and turnover from any ledger (company-books or another). To keep it current: add packs/nl-<year>.json or POST a pack to the host; never edit the engine for a yearly change. If the LAW changes shape (a new deduction, a removed one), bump the pack schema and the engine together.
knownLimits: No fiscal partner, home ownership, box 2/3, AOW age, loss carry-over, KIA/investment deductions, FOR or cross-border income.
Heffingskortingen are estimates; two steps are marked as inference in the worksheet.
VAT summary does not split by rate or fill the official rubrieken.
Only the 2026 pack ships; Zvw and KOR limit rely on one source so far.
It does not file anything: filing is done by the owner or an adviser in Mijn Belastingdienst.
